text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Kh...!?
What... just what on earth is going on...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, no way!
There's nothing we can do about this!

One day, when I went up to the rooftop,
I found Nakayama Festa and Tosen Jordan
looking troubled.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Bystanders, stay back!
This is a danger zone right now!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
B-But still! ...Hey, listen to me!
G-Golshi's acting super weird...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Good morning.
It's another lovely day today, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
It was such a refreshing day,
leaving my heart feeling bright and clear.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
...? Is something the matter,
Trainer-san?
Do I have something on my face?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi's been like this since this morning!
She must've eaten something weird, right?!
I'm sure of it!"

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Or maybe they bumped their head...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a strange thing to say.
I haven't changed at all, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I love how Jordan-san and Nakayama-san are always so cheerful and fun.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Even for me... this is tough to take...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer.
I baked some cookies.
Would you like one?

I accept a cookie from Gold Ship.
A sweet, savory flavor spreads across my tongue.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I am glad it suits your palate.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you enjoy it with such relish...
makes me feel a little bashful, actually."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Urrrghhhh...
I-I'm gonna die...

This is definitely an abnormal situation.
We have to do something.
choice_data_list: Jordan, do you have any good ideas?

text_block_list.text:
This is definitely an abnormal situation.
We have to do something.
choice_data_list: Jordan, do you have any good ideas?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch, me...?
Don't ask the impossible.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: But... in short, we just need to get Golshi back to her usual heated, crazy self, right?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Golshi! I'll indulge you this time in that game you love—
the one where we swap all the sea urchin spines
with chestnut burr needles!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Play this game
and remember the wild self
you were until yesterday...!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on! Let's have a race to see who can swap
sea urchin spines and chestnut burrs the fastest!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? 
Sea urchin spines... and chestnut burrs...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
E-Excuse me...?
I don't quite understand
what you're saying.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Why?
Sea urchin spines and chestnut burrs...?
What's the meaning behind that...?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: You're the one to talk?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
M-My apologies, Nakayama-san.
This game seems to be a bit beyond my comprehension.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, but to each their own hobbies!
I think it's really nice, personally!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Dammiiiit!!!
Nothing seemed to go right, but after a night's sleep, for some reason, she was back to the usual Gold Ship.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: M-Meeeee...!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No way, no way, no way!
There's no way I can handle that!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Hang in there, Jordan, you're our only hope.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Wait...!?
Dodging responsibility like that is the absolute worst...！？

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
G-Grrr……
Grrrrrrrrrr……

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Grrr... grrr...
Grrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: G-Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You can go ahead and kick me...!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Kick me like you always do and get your vibes up! I'll let it slide this once, as a special favor!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
N-No, um...
There's no way I could ever kick
a precious friend like Jordan-san.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ah, c-could it be you're into that sort of thing...?
N-No! Everyone has their own hobbies, after all!
I think it's really wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: DAMMIIIIIT!!!
Nothing seemed to go right, but after a night's sleep, for some reason, she was back to the usual Gold Ship.
